chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ash'ari narrated from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Isa ibn Abdullah, from his father, from his grandfather, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever recites 'Say: He is Allah, One' one hundred times when he takes his rest (goes to sleep), Allah, the Mighty and High, will forgive him the sins of fifty years.

key_terms.حِينَ يَأْخُذُ مِضْجَعَهُ: When he takes his rest / goes to sleep
key_terms.قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ: Say: He is Allah, One (Surah Al-Ikhlas)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas 100 times before sleep?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in his seminal work *al-Tawhid*, this hadith emphasizes the spiritual efficacy of reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas as a nightly ritual for expiation. The promise of forgiveness for fifty years' worth of sins underscores the profound weight of Tawhid (Divine Unity) in Shia devotional practice, linking the affirmation of God's oneness directly to the cleansing of the soul before rest.
